# Test fixtures

Cloud API response bodies, one folder per API type. Every file is listed below; `test_fixtures_catalog.py` fails if one is missing from this catalog or listed but absent.

- **Recorded** files are real responses from a heat pump, merged and sanitised (device code replaced, metadata dropped). The maintainer regenerates them from private probe recordings; don't edit them by hand.
- **Synthetic** files, under `synthetic/`, are written by hand for endpoints that were never recorded. Replace them with recorded ones when possible.

Device code `000000000001` and productId `1132174963097280512` stand for the same unit everywhere. That productId has no dedicated profile, so it falls back to the default one.

## aqua_temp

| File                                 | Endpoint                                                                                     | Source    | Represents                                                                                                                                                                           | Used by                                                           |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `get_data_by_code.idle.json`         | `app/device/getDataByCode`                                                                   | Recorded  | The unit idle, 2026-09-04: every code of the default profile, merged from batched requests. `F10`, `O01`–`O05` and `S01`–`S06` are unknown to the unit (`dataType` and `value` `""`) | `test_fetch_data.py`                                              |
| `synthetic/login.json`               | `app/user/login`                                                                             | Synthetic | Successful login, token `test-token`                                                                                                                                                 | `cloud` fixture                                                   |
| `synthetic/user_info.json`           | `app/user/getUserInfo`                                                                       | Synthetic | User `test-user`                                                                                                                                                                     | `cloud` fixture                                                   |
| `synthetic/device_list.json`         | `app/device/deviceList`                                                                      | Synthetic | One registered device                                                                                                                                                                | `cloud` fixture                                                   |
| `synthetic/device_list_empty.json`   | `app/device/getMyAppectDeviceShareDataList`, `app/device/getMyTobeAppectDeviceShareDataList` | Synthetic | No shared devices                                                                                                                                                                    | `cloud` fixture                                                   |
| `synthetic/device_status.json`       | `app/device/getDeviceStatus`                                                                 | Synthetic | No fault, as a JSON boolean `false`, so the fault endpoint is not called                                                                                                             | `cloud` fixture                                                   |
